body.prose: I think a lot of the terminology here is kind of shite. Like, what it is. In what way sounds logical and functional. By type. Would be understandable. Instead of just saying, you know, store, it is kept in. Or stored in. So honestly, please consider things a bit. And please consider if what you build is the kind of mature feature set that I would come to expect.
body.title: Words that say what they do
